business_summary: Tibet Duo Rui Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of pharmaceutical formulations, chemical intermediates, and peptide APIs in China. It offers fluid therapy, anesthesiology medication, analgesic medication, and first-aid medication products, as well as multiple electrolytes injection; sodium acetate ringer's injection. Tibet Duo Rui Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Tibet, China.
